proposal.summary: The report describes a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in PKP Open Journal Systems (OJS) versions 2.4.8 through 3.3.8, exploitable via Host header/X-Forwarded-Host injection leading to script execution and potential theft of password reset tokens.
proposal.cwe_quote: XSS via Host Header injection and Steal Password Reset Token of another user

proposal.recommended_next_step: Validate the reported Host / X-Forwarded-Host handling by reproducing the injection against an affected instance, confirm JavaScript execution context and whether password reset tokens can be exfiltrated, and apply input validation/encoding or update to a fixed OJS version.
